He began in medical equipment and expanded into shipping, banking and private healthcare. Based in Switzerland, he retained controlling ownership of Medicinos Bankas while developing businesses that supplied and treated patients in Lithuania.

long_biography.plain_text:
A mechanical engineer with a passion for historic cars, Saulius Karosas established restoration facilities in Vilnius and Worms. His collection concentrated on rare vehicles, including important examples from before the Second World War. He presented a Lancia Astura Cabriolet Pininfarina that won the elegance grand prize at Florence's Stefano Ricci Heritage Trophy.

Karosas also returned to the musical world in which he had grown up: his mother was a pianist and his grandfather a composer. Through his charitable foundation, he supported musicians' studies, masterclasses and instrument purchases. His gifts included an organ for the Lithuanian Academy of Music and Theatre.
